title: A really special experience
text:
We booked a hot air balloon ride with Camins de Vent and honestly loved it. Everything was very well organized from the beginning, and the team was friendly and easygoing, which helped a lot because we were a little nervous at first.

Once we were up in the air, it was such an amazing feeling. The views were beautiful and everything felt so peaceful. It’s hard to describe, but it was one of those experiences that you just stop and enjoy in the moment. The pilot was great too — very calm, professional, and happy to answer questions.

What I liked most was that it never felt rushed or too touris
author: joebV634PU

title: Amazing
text: This was an amazing experience, truly relaxing, and the views are absolutely incredible. My wife and I booked this excursion and the hospitality from the crew was second to none. Awesome.

title: Flying High
text: We were celebrating my daughter’s high school graduation.  We both were nervous, but our pilot was wonderful.  The overall experience was great!
author: Jennifer_C

title: Fantastic Balloon Ride
text: From the start communications we're prompt and helpful.  Clear instructions and costs were set out at the start.  On the day staff were friendly and professional. The balloon and equipment were to a very high standard and the flight was amazing with a very experienced pilot.   I would recommend anyone looking to do a hot air balloon to use these guys.  An amazing experience and good value.  Thank you for a great and memorable morning.
author: Jackie M

title: Up, Up and Away!
text: Loved the views and it was very peaceful. I was expecting to feel something when we started floating up in the air but it was extremely smooth. Great birthday gift and highly recommend you give it a shot!
author: 163colec

title: Great experience and competence of the team
text: Nice experience, and good weather for this balloon flight, the pilot was very friendly and we enjoyed his landscape descriptions, I recommend

title: Amazing experience!
text: Super recommended, it has been a unique experience from the beginning and preparation of the balloon, flight and even landing. The views from the globe without amazing, whatever place you choose you will enjoy it!
author: soledadii

title: AN EXPERIENCE 10!
text: We did the balloon flight on the Costa Brava and it was great! A 10 for pilot Aleix and the whole team! The flight very quiet and without any incident, Aleix is very professional and answered all our questions, we asked him a few! At the end we have collected the balloon between us all and have had a glass of cava! An experience 10 in every way!
